character: Independent, family-oriented ski area in the hills of Allegany County in western New York, with about 650 ft (198 m) of vertical, four chairlifts plus a carpet and near-complete snowmaking coverage. It has its own lodging and has been an Indy Pass partner since the 2020-21 season.
learning: Research found only partial beginner information: the lift roster includes one magic carpet, and the Indy Pass listing mentions children's programs. Lesson program names and the beginner-area layout were not found.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-28. OnTheSnow (third party) projects an opening of 2026-12-19 and a closing of 2027-03-28; these are projections, not announcements (https://www.onthesnow.com/new-york/swain/ski-resort). No historical opening dates were found.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-13 south to the Elmira/Horseheads area, I-86 west to Hornell, then NY-36 north through Arkport toward Swain); not a routing-service result. Expect about 1 h 50 min to 2 h in good conditions.

reportSource.notes: No official snow-report URL appeared in research; check swain.com. OnTheSnow carries a third-party page.

Region: one search summary called Swain 'northwestern New York'. It is in Allegany County (Southern Tier / Western NY), and 'Western New York' was used.
research.confidenceNotes: The web-search budget ran out before Swain-specific searches beyond the Indy results, so coverage is thin. Medium confidence: vertical 650 ft, 4 chairs + 1 carpet and 35 runs (Indy Pass page); 100 acres and 97% snowmaking (OnTheSnow); the Indy partnership. The coordinates and summit point are unsourced approximations for weather-model use only. Drive time is a Piste estimate.
